Row.Text: Coastal Cities gain +2 [ICON_GOLD] Gold and +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture. After Civil Service, Jungle tiles worked by Kadamba cities yield +1 [ICON_PRODUCTION] Production. Trade Routes generate +25% Gold. After discovering a technology, cities gain +15% Production toward buildings for 8 turns. Units receive +10% Combat Strength in friendly lands.

Unique Kadamba replacement for the Temple. Provides +2 [ICON_PEACE] Faith, +1 [ICON_CULTURE] Culture, and +10% Production when constructing Wonders in this city. Newly trained land units receive +5 XP.
The Kadamba Temple represents the dynasty's stone temple tradition and its fusion of sacred legitimacy, regional identity, and royal prestige.
Build Kadamba Temples in high-production or coastal cities to support Faith, Culture, and Wonder construction.
Replaces the Swordsman. Receives +20% Combat Strength in Forest and Jungle and ignores Jungle movement penalties.
Forest Guards are elite defenders of the Konkan forests, trained to fight among dense terrain and protect temple-cities from outside powers.
Use Forest Guards to dominate wooded chokepoints and defend jungle-heavy territory.
+20% Combat Strength in Forest and Jungle.

Great Mayurasharma, founder of a realm born from defiance, your people rose from the forests of the Konkan coast to build a kingdom of temples, trade, and quiet strength. Will wisdom defend itself once more?
Mayurasharma is remembered as the founder of the Kadamba realm, a figure of scholarly origin whose legacy suits a civilization built around learning, defense, temples, and regional sovereignty.
The Kadambas ruled across parts of the western Deccan and Konkan region, with a design here focused on coastal prosperity, jungle development, temple culture, and resilient defense.
